Now: put T-455 to T-465 in T-466's blockers and keep working them in plan order (T-455 knowledge, T-456 guides, T-457 kits, T-458 zip, T-459 cards, T-460 packs, then T-461/T-462 test loops, T-463 spot checks, T-464 real-account round with revert ledger, T-465 Fable critic). Then set status to review and give Adi full cache-busted links (?v=t466): the review centre, the zip, the chat edition, the prompt pack endpoint and the test transcripts. Do not deploy live until Adi approves.
